Quarto.question: The _____ was Technical term describing the format of a book.
Quarto.fact: Quarto (abbreviated Qto, 4to or 4º) is the format of a book or pamphlet produced from full sheets printed with eight pages of text, four to a side, then folded twice to produce four leaves.
